dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Non-REM parasomnia (sleep terror / confusional arousal), arising from disordered arousal out of N3 slow-wave sleep

Alternatives (in order of likelihood):
1. Nocturnal frontal lobe epilepsy (despite negative interictal EEG and normal MRI, an ictal EEG was obscured by movement artefact)
2. REM sleep behaviour disorder (despite denial of dream enactment, recall is often poor in RBD)
3. Psychogenic non-epileptic sleep-related events
